import os, urllib.request, urllib.error
print('no_proxy env:', os.environ.get('no_proxy'), os.environ.get('NO_PROXY'))
print('http_proxy env:', os.environ.get('http_proxy'), os.environ.get('HTTP_PROXY'))
print('getproxies():', urllib.request.getproxies())
url='http://160.202.254.160:10986/'
for name,mk in [('default',lambda: urllib.request.build_opener()),
                ('explicit',lambda: urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({'http':'http://127.0.0.1:12001'}))),
                ('noproxy',lambda: urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({})))]:
    try:
        op=mk()
        with op.open(url,timeout=15) as r:
            b=r.read()
        print(name,'OK len=',len(b))
    except Exception as e:
        print(name,'FAIL',type(e).__name__,str(e)[:200])
